Require executed cases for each test owner

A mixed invocation could report PASS when one owner ran named cases
and another reported only empty or skipped cases. Require positive
executed-case coverage for every expected or observed owner, aggregated
across its attempts and shards.

Retain native and XML failures as the primary verdict. Cover mixed
owners and an empty shard whose owner executes cases in another shard.
